name: MV.tech
summary: MV.tech is a remote-first data engineering, software development and AI consultancy based in Ahmedabad, India. It builds cloud warehouses and ETL pipelines, warehouse migrations, semantic and BI layers, workflow automation and AI systems using RAG, MCP servers and custom AI connectors. Its senior specialists work with clients worldwide, planning working hours that overlap any timezone, with a lean model that avoids large-consultancy overhead.
shortSummary: Remote-first data, software and AI engineering team based in Ahmedabad, India, working in any client timezone.

founder.name: Meet Vaghasia
founder.description: Meet Vaghasia is the founder of MV.tech. He is a senior data and AI engineer who builds ETL pipelines and cloud warehouses on BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift and PostgreSQL, semantic and reporting layers for Power BI, Tableau and Looker Studio, and AI automation using RAG, MCP servers and custom AI connectors. He is Toptal-vetted (Top 3%) and holds the Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer certification and IBM Big Data Engineer and Artificial Intelligence Analyst Mastery Awards.

credentials.name: IBM Big Data Engineer Mastery Award
